review.assessment:
The change replaces a naive frequency script with a pipeline that splits input on any whitespace, lowercases all characters to enforce case-insensitivity, filters out empty lines produced by consecutive whitespace or trailing newlines, sorts alphabetically to group identical tokens, counts them with `uniq -c`, re-sorts by count descending and word ascending for tie-breaking, and formats the output with a single space separator. This implementation directly satisfies all specified requirements for splitting behavior, case normalization, ordering logic, and final output format.

No defects were found.
